Theme for this month by Mary, "The artist this month is American painter Mary Pinchot Meyer, born October 14, 1920: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mary_Pinchot_Meyer

A Libra Sun native, with Venus and Mercury in Scorpio (and Juno, NN, and possibly the Moon).

Her abstract paintings depict very Libran themes of color, light, relationships and balance, while her life and tragic death makes for quite a scandalous story; her ex-husband was a high ranking CIA operative, she had an affair with JFK... and she was murdered via a professional hit job, and an innocent black man was accused of the deed and later acquitted.

The painting used for the slide deck is titled "Half Light," and housed at the Smithsonian https://americanart.si.edu/artist/mary-pinchot-meyer-3301

items.title: October Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A detailed look at the astrology forecast for October 2026, with astrologer Chris Brennan. 

This month is dominated by a tumultuous Venus retrograde in Scorpio, kicking off alongside intense hard aspects to Mars and Pluto, which will dredge up some challenging things from the past.

Tensions are further heightened as Mercury slows down and stations retrograde in Scorpio later in the month, bringing communication breakdowns and the need for significant retooling.

I explore the historical precedents for these transits and break down how to navigate this tough astrological weather before the planets finally station direct and offer resolution in mid-November.

This is episode 551 of The Astrology Podcast.
